# Keep the Light 1.35.0

- **Double episodes.** When TMDB counts one file as two episodes, every later episode used to be looked up one number short. The Plex names tab now spots such a file (or you mark it), renumbers the rest of the season to match TMDB in one undoable step, and names the double one like "S05E09-E10" so Plex shows both.
- **Target file size follows double episodes:** a double episode gets twice the size, automatically.
